comment: anchor_write_guard: stop blocking a plain 'git pull'/'git fetch' against a worktree-class anchor. The guard's invariant is 'no agent-authored content lands in the anchor' -- a pull can only ever bring in commits that already exist upstream, so it structurally cannot violate that. Other git mutation verbs (commit, checkout, reset, merge, rebase, etc.) remain blocked. cross_repo_guard keeps its own independent copy of the write-verb list and is unaffected.
